#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "audit-demo: 3 file(s) scanned"
echo "audit-demo: $n match(es) found"
# Reads every entr(y|ies) of the list.
printf '%s\n' "$n director(ies) left"
echo "audit-demo: $(plural "$n" file files) scanned"
awk 'function trim(s) { return s } { n = length(s); print trim(s) }' /dev/null
echo "audit-demo: scanned the file(s); done"
printf '%s\n' "(checked every leg(s))"
echo "for each crate(s) { read it }"
echo "the scheme is http or https"
echo "the function file(s) are missing"
echo "length(s) of the files"
function first_of(s) { echo "$1"; }
awk '
function first(s) { return s }
{ print length(s), toupper(s) }
' /dev/null
awk -f - /dev/null <<'AWK'
{ print toupper(s), trim(s) }
function last(s) { return s }
AWK
awk -f lib.awk "$f" # it's the lib
echo "the length(s) of the files"
awk "
function second(s) { return s }
{ print length(s), \$1 }
" /dev/null
echo "after the program, tolower(s) is prose"
